topic_title: Learning Basic HTML with Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat
goal: Use Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat to learn HTML basics, generate a working page example, and understand individual HTML elements.
technical_facts: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language and is the standard language used to build web pages.
Copilot can generate a complete HTML page structure, including the html, head, title, body, h1, and p elements.
The h1 element defines the primary heading on a web page.
The h2 element creates subsection headings.

tasks.description: Starting point for anyone new to HTML — asking Copilot for a definition.

steps.action: From the Copilot home page, type "What is HTML?" into the chat box.
steps.details: This is usually the first question someone new to HTML would ask.
steps.expected_outcome: Copilot responds that HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language and is the standard language used to build web pages.

tasks.task_name: Ask Copilot for a simple HTML example
tasks.description: Request a working example to see HTML structure in practice.

steps.action: Type "Show me a simple HTML example."
steps.details: Copilot can provide examples in addition to definitions.
steps.expected_outcome:
Copilot generates a basic HTML page example with the full page structure: My First Page

Hello World

This is my first webpage.

tasks.description: Dig deeper into specific elements from the generated example, such as h1 and h2.

steps.expected_outcome: Copilot explains that the h1 element defines the primary heading on a web page.

steps.action: Ask Copilot the difference between h1 and h2.
steps.details: A common question people ask once they understand the h1 element.
steps.expected_outcome: Copilot explains that the h1 element represents the primary page heading, while h2 elements create subsection headings.

tasks.description: Once the basics are understood, use follow-up questions to build more complete pages and understand why the generated code works.

steps.action: Ask Copilot to generate a complete sample web page using headings and paragraphs.
steps.details: Builds on the basic example by combining multiple elements.
steps.expected_outcome: Copilot generates a fuller HTML page example using headings and paragraphs.

steps.action: Ask Copilot to explain why the generated code works.
steps.details: You can continue asking follow-up questions until you understand each element.
steps.expected_outcome: Copilot explains the purpose and behavior of each element in the generated code.
